A GDPR purpose doesn't change that restriction, and an export without these fields would be incomplete for your records. Please ask your data protection officer or the system owner with authorised access to run the full export.

If it helps, I can write a query for customer 8's non-personal columns only: customer_id, company_name, country, segment, created_at, first_order_date, last_order_date, lifetime_orders and lifetime_net_revenue. It would not be a complete GDPR export.
